heading: I make complex ideas feel clear, useful, and human.
intro: I am a product-minded designer with a foundation in technical communication. I move comfortably between product questions, UX flows, visual systems, words, and working prototypes.
story: For more than fifteen years, I have worked where knowledge, systems, and people meet. Technical communication taught me to find the real question, understand unfamiliar systems quickly, and make complexity navigable.

Today I bring that same clarity into product design. I use code and AI-assisted development as thinking materials: a way to test behavior, uncover gaps, and carry an idea further than a static screen.

strengths.title: Product clarity
strengths.copy: Frame the right problem and give teams a shared language.

strengths.title: Design craft
strengths.copy: Build calm, legible interfaces with strong content hierarchy.

strengths.title: Technical fluency
strengths.copy: Understand constraints, prototype behavior, and collaborate closely with engineering.

howIWork: Start with the question, not the feature list.
Use writing and rough prototypes to make assumptions visible.
Design the system and the edge cases, not only the happy path.
Keep learning from the working thing.
experience: 15+ years across technical communication, information architecture, UX, product thinking, documentation systems, and independent digital experiments.
